art_style: Mochiichao art style of record (repo canon art); NO baked-in shadows (composite-time only)

bone_layers.deform: only weighted bones/layers; URS invariants measured here: <=4 influences per vertex, weights sum to 1, welded, zero NaN
bone_layers.mechanism: IK/snap/pole machinery, gait helpers, lattice drivers; zero weights, always (leg instancing multiplies mechanism, not deform)

components.note: ONE leg component instanced x4 (Sprite Fright spider precedent: x8). Gait groups FL/FR/BL/BR.

deformation.smear_frames: dedicated smear drawings for gallop/pounce extension frames (house style)
deformation.squash_stretch: belly + back line carry quadruped squash; volume-preserving on torso groups

face_system.method: stepped library of approved cry/expression shapes (2D: Graphic symbol frames; 3D: action-driven poses) - creatures are cries-only; NO viseme set on creatures

gate: Universal Rig Standard adapted: ROM battery (incl. all three gaits) is a generated test pose set run on every version + before/after proof frames reviewed by eye; 3D stretch gate p99.9 < 2.5; no ship without pass

generation.method: scaffold_is_metarig: quadruped proportions (leg length, neck length, back line) are scaffold edits + regenerate - the workflow Autumn's BlenRig build was hand-made to survive, automated (RIG-TEARDOWN sec.5)
generation.post_gen_notes: house tweaks live here, never as hand edits to a generated rig

lattice_patches.purpose: breathing, landing squash - classic quadruped failure area

shape_key_budget: <=10 corrective shape keys / drawings per rig (open-movie discipline)
source_system: open-movie rig teardown (RIG-TEARDOWN.md): quadruped template economics - Autumn re-proportioning workflow + spider leg instancing

mouth.note: Creature cry/expression shapes ONLY - no Blair visemes on creatures (cries-only law; visemes are humans-only via mochiichao-mouth-data/v1)
